name: Ducati Hypermotard 1100 / 796
engine: 803 or 1078 cc air-cooled two-valve desmo V-twin, fuel injected
intro: The first Hypermotards. Air-cooled DS engines, a tall supermoto stance and a dry clutch on the 1100.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.
K: Many of these have a dry clutch. The rattle is normal, but check the plates and the basket for notches.

recallNote: Ducati has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
